comment: The sine runs at twice the frequency the code's own variable names: src/modules/Clave.hh:52 advances the phase by frequency * rSampleRate * 2 while :54 takes sin(2 * M_PIF * phase), and M_PIF is pi (4ms cpputil util/math.hh:17), so one cycle takes sampleRate/(2*frequency) samples. With frequency set to 1000 + control * 750 at :52 the sounding range is 2000Hz to 3500Hz, not the 1kHz to 2kHz the knob's tooltip and the manual give. The decay range 5ms to 25ms at :76-77 matches the manual.
